$comment: Profiles: ready-made selections of this library, each for one kind of work. An install that names one (--profile <name>, MCP_PROMPTS_PROFILE, or ?profile=<name> in an HTTP URL) serves only these prompts, so list_prompts returns a fraction of the library. Entries are groups (directories), prompt ids or tag:<tag>, as for --prompts and --templates; 'prompts' lists plain prompts and 'templates' lists templates. Run 'mcp-prompts profiles' to see what each serves and which prompts are in none.
